Medicaid Bulletin Digests

The Medicaid Monthly Bulletin Digest is a compilation of all Medicaid Bulletins and Special Bulletins distributed in a specific month. The Digest is a convenient way to review Medicaid Bulletins monthly rather than as each is posted.

Articles are posted to the Medicaid Bulletin webpage as they are approved. Articles published prior to 2018 are available in the Medicaid Bulletin Archive. 

Providers can sign up to receive email updates from NCTracks, which includes links to Medicaid Bulletins shortly after they are published. Please note, emails include all updates to Providers. 

If you have questions about retrieving articles, please email the Medicaid Communications team at Medicaid.Communications@dhhs.nc.gov.
